{
  "name": "themes",
  "displayName": "Claude Code Themes",
  "description": "Draws Claude's replies in color: headings, bold, italics, inline code, links, list markers and highlighted code blocks, in a Monokai Pro theme. Display only: the stored transcript and what Claude reads are unchanged.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Danish Mughal",
    "url": "https://github.com/danishmughal"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/danishmughal/claude-code-themes",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "theme",
    "monokai",
    "markdown",
    "syntax-highlighting"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme",
      "description": "The palette replies are drawn in. Pick the one your terminal theme uses.",
      "options": [
        "monokai-pro",
        "monokai-pro-classic",
        "monokai-pro-machine",
        "monokai-pro-octagon",
        "monokai-pro-ristretto",
        "monokai-pro-spectrum"
      ],
      "default": "monokai-pro-classic"
    }
  }
}
